content:
Role Details

  • Location: This role is based 3 days per week out of our San Francisco, HQ and is not eligible for full-time remote work. 
  • Compensation: The annual cash compensation range for this position is $190,000–$260,000 based on level in addition to equity & benefits.

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum compensation. Factors including location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience will determine compensation.

About Gem

Gem is the only AI-first all-in-one recruiting platform. It brings together your ATS, CRM, sourcing, scheduling, and analytics — plus 800+ million profiles to source from — with AI built into every workflow. By eliminating the headaches of juggling multiple tools, Gem helps customers boost recruiter productivity by up to 5x while saving 30-50% on technology costs. Over 1,000 organizations — from startups to industry leaders like Zillow, DoorDash, and Asana — trust Gem to fuel their growth. With an industry-leading 4.8/5 rating on G2, Gem is the platform recruiters actually love to use. Gem has raised $148M from renown investors including Accel, Greylock, ICONIQ, Sapphire, and Meritech.

With Gem, you can experience the power of a truly connected recruiting platform — one consistent interface, unified data, smarter AI recommendations, and simplified permissions. Our customers achieve remarkable results.

Just as we strive to help our customers find great talent, we also invest in our own people and culture. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and have recently been recognized as: 
  • Forbes America's Best Startup Employers 2026
  • Great Place to Work Certified, 2024
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, 2023


The Team and Role

  • Gem engineers work closely with product managers and designers to influence product direction, company roadmap, and business outcomes.
  • We stay close to customers by joining customer calls, and reading customer feedback.
  • We enjoy shipping features, moving fast, and being scrappy.
  • We are receptive to feedback and continuously work on improving both our product and our craft.
  • We work out of our San Francisco office.
  • Read more about our company values.

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

  • Own product features end-to-end alongside your product manager, engineering manager and designer.
  • Work primarily with Typescript, React, Python, GraphQL, Node, PostgreSQL.
  • Collaborate with engineers on your team and across Gem on code reviews, data model, architecture, and product decisions.
  • Stay close to our customers.
  • Embody our company values of ownership, velocity, customer centricity, diversity and transparency.
  • Influence decisions and have direct impact on business outcomes.

About You

  • You have industry experience as a software engineer, building user-facing products.
  • You move with velocity and invest in improving your craft.
  • You are good at driving solutions by communicating and working cross-functionally.
  • You are energized by collaborating in-office with your peers.

Benefits

  • Highly competitive salary & equity
  • 10-year window to exercise your stock options
  • Supportive Flexible Time Off program
  • 16 paid holidays, including regular company-wide wellness days
  • Best-in-class medical, dental & vision insurance
  • $1,200 annual stipend for learning and development opportunities
  • 16 weeks of Paid Parental Leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • New Parent Perks totaling $1,500 and flexibility upon return to work

Gem is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and encourage folks of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. At Gem, we’re committed to having an inclusive and transparent environment where every voice is heard and acknowledged. We embrace our differences, and know that our diverse team is a strength that drives our success. 
 
Gem is committed to developing a barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. If you require any accommodation, please email us at accommodations@gem.com and we’ll work with you to meet your accessibility needs.
 
Gem’s Candidate Privacy Notice
By clicking “Submit Application”, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand Gem’s Candidate Privacy Statement, including the information provided on how Gem processes your personal data and your related rights as set forth therein.

content:
About Gem

Gem is the only AI-first all-in-one recruiting platform. It brings together your ATS, CRM, sourcing, scheduling, and analytics — plus 800+ million profiles to source from — with AI built into every workflow. By eliminating the headaches of juggling multiple tools, Gem helps customers boost recruiter productivity by up to 5x while saving 30-50% on technology costs. Over 1,000 organizations — from startups to industry leaders like Zillow, DoorDash, and Asana — trust Gem to fuel their growth. With an industry-leading 4.8/5 rating on G2, Gem is the platform recruiters actually love to use. Gem has raised $148M from renown investors including Accel, Greylock, ICONIQ, Sapphire, and Meritech.

With Gem, you can experience the power of a truly connected recruiting platform — one consistent interface, unified data, smarter AI recommendations, and simplified permissions. Our customers achieve remarkable results.

Just as we strive to help our customers find great talent, we also invest in our own people and culture. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and have recently been recognized as: 
  • Forbes America's Best Startup Employers 2026
  • Great Place to Work Certified, 2024
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, 2023


The Team and Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our ATS team, one of the most strategically important areas of Gem’s product suite.

For two years, we’ve been building our ATS architecture from the ground up, working closely with top companies to design a modern, AI-powered system that reimagines how recruiting teams operate. Now, we are entering an exciting new phase: we are iterating rapidly, and preparing to launch with some of the largest and most recognizable industry partners.

As a senior member of this team, you will play a critical role in:
  • Designing the architecture of a system that is elegant today and will scale in the future.
  • Making foundational technical decisions that will define how Gem's ATS evolves for years to come.
  • Directly collaborating with customers, ensuring that what we build addresses the needs of large-scale modern recruiting teams.

We're looking for someone who balances hands-on development with long-term thinking: an engineer who can move fast but also sees around corners. This role also provides a clear growth path: you'll have the chance to mentor other engineers, take on technical leadership, and shape both product and team culture as we continue to grow.

Read more about our company values.

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

  • Own product features end-to-end, from ideation to implementation.
  • Build and scale user-facing features with Typescript, React, Python, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL.
  • Ensure scalability and reliability by collaborating with other engineers on data model, architecture, and product decisions.
  • Stay close to customers, gathering direct feedback to inform design and development decisions.
  • Embody our company values of ownership, velocity, customer centricity, diversity and transparency.
  • Mentor and guide teammates, sharing your technical expertise and helping elevate the engineering bar.
  • Influence company and product direction, making decisions that have immediate visible impact on our customers.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver thoughtful, high-quality solutions.
  • Work with a world class team from Meta, Uber, Dropbox, and more

About You
  • You have 5+ years of industry experience as a software engineer, building user-facing products.
  • You enjoy mentoring, working cross-functionally, and working directly with customers.
  • You move with velocity and invest in improving your craft.
  • You prioritize technical quality, building reliable and scalable systems.
  • You are product-oriented and you don’t hesitate in making decisions.
  • You are energized by collaborating in-office with your peers in a hybrid model.


How We Work

We've removed most development friction:
  • Local dev with Vite boots instantly with hot-reload
  • CI runs in ~10 minutes, deploys go straight to production
  • We ship fast and iterate based on customer feedback
Our engineering culture:
  • Reasonable hours
  • Weekly team events and happy hours
  • Regular hackathons for experimental features
  • Team from Meta, Uber, and Dropbox

Role Details

  • Location: This role is based 3 days per week out of our San Francisco, HQ and is not eligible for full-time remote work. 
  • Compensation: The annual cash compensation range for this position is $190,000–$260,000 based on level in addition to equity & benefits.

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum compensation. Factors including location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience will determine compensation.

Benefits

  • Highly competitive salary & equity
  • 10-year window to exercise your stock options
  • Supportive Flexible Time Off program
  • 16 paid holidays, including regular company-wide wellness days
  • Best-in-class medical, dental & vision insurance
  • $1,200 annual stipend for learning and development opportunities
  • 16 weeks of Paid Parental Leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • New Parent Perks totaling $1,500 and flexibility upon return to work

Gem is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and encourage folks of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. At Gem, we’re committed to having an inclusive and transparent environment where every voice is heard and acknowledged. We embrace our differences, and know that our diverse team is a strength that drives our success. 
 
Gem is committed to developing a barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. If you require any accommodation, please email us at accommodations@gem.com and we’ll work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Core ATS

content:
About Gem


Gem is the only AI-first all-in-one recruiting platform. It brings together an ATS, CRM, sourcing, scheduling, and analytics with AI built into every workflow. By eliminating the headaches of juggling multiple tools, Gem helps customers boost recruiter productivity by up to 5x while saving 30-50% on technology costs. Over 1,000 organizations — from startups to industry leaders like Zillow, DoorDash, and Asana — trust Gem to fuel their growth. With an industry-leading 4.8/5 rating on G2, Gem is the platform recruiters actually love to use. Gem has raised $148M from renown investors including Accel, Greylock, ICONIQ, Sapphire, and Meritech.

Just as we strive to help our customers find great talent, we also invest in our own people and culture. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and have recently been recognized as: 
  • Forbes America's Best Startup Employers 2026
  • Great Place to Work Certified, 2024
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, 2023


Role and Day-to-Day


As a Product Manager at Gem, you will own one of Gem’s top line product areas end-to-end:
  • Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a major product area, making tradeoffs across customer impact, technical constraints, and long-term company strategy.
  • Meet with customers regularly and deeply understand the market.
  • Own product outcomes through metrics, customer feedback, and rapid iteration.
  • Partner with Gem’s GTM team to bring your products to market.

Gem AI

AI Sourcing and AI Application Review are Gem’s newest and fastest growing products. Built from the ground up on a modern LLM architecture, they deliver significantly more accurate search results and allow recruiters to prioritize inbound applications.
  • Shape the future of agentic AI recruiting.
  • Own search, retrieval, and AI-driven discovery experiences at scale.
  • Work with a team of 10+ engineers, partnering closely with a dedicated engineering manager and product designer.
  • Partner with Marketing to establish Gem as a thought leader in AI Recruiting.
  • Work with Gem’s AI Governance Group to innovate and build ethical AI products.


Gem ATS

Launched two years ago, Gem’s Applicant Tracking System is now the hiring source of truth for hundreds of paying customers.
  • Bring end-to-end AI workflows to a massive product category full of legacy products.
  • Balance the roadmap across Gem’s entire spectrum of customers: from Gem’s PLGs startup program all the way up to our leading Enterprise Design Partners.
  • Work with a team of 10+ engineers, partnering closely with a dedicated engineering manager and product designer.
  • Partner closely with Design, Success, and Support to build intuitive user experiences for complex workflows.
  • Work with Partnerships to establish Gem ATS as the leading ecosystem in the recruiting space.


About You

  • 5-10 years of experience as a product manager, building and owning world-class tech products.
  • On top of the latest in AI and using AI in your daily workflows.
  • Strong product taste and obsession about user experience.
  • Comfort in partnering deeply with engineers on technical tradeoffs that materially affect product quality and outcomes.
  • A track record of setting product strategy and direction, not just executing predefined roadmaps.
  • (Bonus) Experience building AI-powered products, especially in search, retrieval, ranking, or content discovery.


Role Details

  • Location: This role is based 3 days per week out of our San Francisco HQ and is not eligible for full-time remote work.
  • Compensation: The annual cash compensation range for this position is $220,000–$250,000 based on level in addition to equity & benefits.

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum compensation. Factors including location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience will determine compensation.

Gem is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and encourage folks of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. At Gem, we’re committed to having an inclusive and transparent environment where every voice is heard and acknowledged. We embrace our differences, and know that our diverse team is a strength that drives our success. Gem is committed to developing a barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. If you require any accommodation, please email us at accommodations@gem.com and we’ll work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum compensation. Factors including level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience will determine compensation.

  • Forbes America's Best Startup Employers 2026
  • Great Place to Work Certified, 2024
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, 2023


The Team and Role


We’re hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our AI Products engineering team.

The AI Products team owns the AI agents and intelligence layer powering Gem’s top-of-funnel products including sourcing, application review, and outbound campaigns.

The team is responsible for building AI-powered experiences, as well as defining how we measure, evaluate, and improve model quality in production.

More about us:
  • Gem engineers and engineering managers work closely with product managers and designers on product direction and roadmap.
  • We stay close to customers by joining customer calls, and reading customer feedback.
  • We enjoy shipping features, moving fast, and being scrappy.
  • We are receptive to feedback and continuously work on improving both our product and our craft.
  • We work out of our San Francisco office.
  • Read more about our company values.

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of fullstack and AI engineers building AI-powered product experiences
  • Set direction and guide technical strategy.
  • Partner with Product and Design to define the AI roadmap and experimentation strategy
  • Own AI quality end-to-end 
  • Balance rapid experimentation with production-grade reliability
  • Embody Gem’s company values of ownership, velocity, customer centricity, diversity and transparency.
  • Engage with customers to understand how AI performance translates to business impact

About You

  • You have hired and managed exceptional engineering teams
  • You have at least 5+ years of industry experience as a software engineer
  • You have experience leading AI-powered product initiatives from prototype to production
  • You care deeply about quality and understand how to build effective evaluation frameworks
  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to complex technical problems
  • You collaborate effectively with product managers and designers to shape roadmap and technical direction
  • You demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for outcomes

The Team and Role
We’re hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our AI Products engineering team.
The AI Products team owns the AI agents and intelligence layer powering Gem’s top-of-funnel products including sourcing, application review, and outbound campaigns. 
The team is responsible for building AI-powered experiences, as well as defining how we measure, evaluate, and improve model quality in production.
More about us:
Gem engineers and engineering managers work closely with product managers and designers on product direction and roadmap.
We stay close to customers by joining customer calls, and reading customer feedback.
We enjoy shipping features, moving fast, and being scrappy.
We are receptive to feedback and continuously work on improving both our product and our craft.
We work out of our San Francisco office.
